segments.sn35.126:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nāḷandāyaṃ viharati pāvārikambavane.
segments.sn35.126:1.2: Atha kho, upāli gahapati, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho, upāli gahapati, bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.126:1.3: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti?
segments.sn35.126:1.4: Ko pana, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantī”ti?
segments.sn35.126:1.6: Ayaṃ kho, gahapati, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantīti.

lines: 124-126. Gahapativaggassa paṭhame uggoti paṇītadāyakānaṃ aggauggo, so bhagavatā “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ paṇītadāyakānaṃ yadidaṃ uggo gahapatī”ti evaṃ etadagge ṭhapito.
Sesametesu ceva dvīsu, tatiye ca vuttatthameva.
124-126. Dvīsūti imasmiṃ gahapativagge paṭhamadutiyesu tatiye ca vuttatthameva pāṭhajātaṃ apubbaṃ natthīti attho.
